acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `cell_type` with the exact meaning the spec states: enumeration | `cell.text`, `cell.graphic`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `top_inset`, `left_inset`, `bottom_inset`, `right_inset` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric, `pt` | text-cell insets. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `text_top_inset`, `text_bottom_inset`, `text_left_inset`, `text_right_inset` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric, `pt` | a SECOND inset group, distinct from the first; both are captured and both are required. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `graphic_top_inset`, `graphic_bottom_inset`, `graphic_left_inset`, `graphic_right_inset` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric, `pt` | graphic-cell insets. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `clip_content_to_cell`, `clip_content_to_text_cell`, `clip_content_to_graphic_cell` with the exact meaning the spec states: booleans | three independent clips, one general and two per cell type. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `vertical_justification` with the exact meaning the spec states: enumeration | [STU-LAY-121]. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `first_baseline_offset`, `minimum_first_baseline_offset` with the exact meaning the spec states: enumeration + numeric | [STU-LAY-120]. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `rotation_angle` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric, `deg` | the captured value domain is the four quarter turns for cell text. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `text_cell_rotation_follows_story_direction` with the exact meaning the spec states: boolean. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `row_span`, `column_span` with the exact meaning the spec states: integers, `count`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `minimum_height`, `maximum_height` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric, `pt` | the row-height at-least/exactly behaviour is expressed as this pair. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `keep_with_next_row` with the exact meaning the spec states: boolean. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `start_row` with the exact meaning the spec states: enumeration | start this row on the next frame, page, odd page or even page. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `auto_grow` with the exact meaning the spec states: boolean. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.
The enumeration accepts the member `paragraph_spacing_limit` with the exact meaning the spec states: numeric, `pt`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `diagonal_line_in_front` with the exact meaning the spec states: boolean | draw the diagonal above or below the cell content. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `top_left_diagonal_line`, `top_right_diagonal_line` with the exact meaning the spec states: booleans | the two diagonals are independent; both true gives the crossed form. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `fill_colour`, `fill_tint`, `overprint_fill` with the exact meaning the spec states: -- | plus `gradient_fill_length`, `gradient_fill_angle` (hard -180..180 `deg`), `gradient_fill_start`. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `applied_cell_style_priority` with the exact meaning the spec states: integer | the precedence used to resolve conflicting styles at a shared edge. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `top_edge_stroke_priority` and the three siblings` with the exact meaning the spec states: integers | edge-conflict resolution between adjacent cells. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence or table row in the cited spec clause. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication and fails the contract.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
For a parameter row, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown rather than mirrored from its opposite.
